name: Neria (Baruch's father)
title: Father of the prophet's scribe
summary: Neria was the father of Baruch, who served as the faithful scribe and secretary to the prophet Jeremiah. Through his son Baruch, Neria's family became closely linked to the prophet's ministry during one of Judah's most dramatic periods. He was also the father of Seraiah, who received an important mission from Jeremiah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as Baruch's father
keyEvents.description: Neria is identified as the father of Baruch, the scribe who wrote down Jeremiah's prophecies on a scroll.

keyEvents.title: Baruch's mission with the scroll
keyEvents.description: Baruch, son of Neria, read publicly from the scroll containing the words of Jeremiah in the temple.

keyEvents.title: Father of Seraiah
keyEvents.description: Neria was also the father of Seraiah, who was commissioned by Jeremiah to bring a prophecy to Babylon.

keyEvents.title: The family's connection to the royal house
keyEvents.description: Seraj son of Neriah is mentioned as the chief official and accompanied King Zedekiah to Babylon, suggesting the family's high status.
